purpose: Three candidate turns and under ninety seconds on the floor before the candidate leaves. The assessment has to say it was short and treat the scores as low-confidence; the notable answers must not be padded to reach a count; the two gaps that were never asked about are not_raised.

context.jobDescription: Lumen Health is looking for a Frontend Engineer to build patient-facing web apps in React and TypeScript. Required: 3+ years with React; TypeScript; accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) in shipped products; automated testing with Playwright or Cypress. Nice to have: design system experience.
context.analysisSummary: React and TypeScript are met. Accessibility is partly covered: the resume mentions semantic HTML but no WCAG work or audits. End-to-end testing is missing entirely; only unit tests appear.

requirements.evidence: Semantic HTML and keyboard navigation on the booking flow
requirements.note: No WCAG audit, no mention of screen readers or contrast.

requirements.requirement: Automated testing with Playwright or Cypress
